title: Compatibility of a right-adjoint mate with an open in the new base
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation and g:Y′→Y a morphism between qcqs bases, with X′=X×_Y Y′. Choose right adjoints a,a′ to the canonical lifted derived direct images and their adjunctions, and assume ordinary derived base change for this square. Fix K in D_QCoh(Y) and an affine open W⊂Y′. Choose a right adjoint c to the canonical lifted direct image X×_Y W→W, with its adjunction, and assume ordinary derived base change for f along W→Y′→Y. Let r:f′⁻¹(W)→X×_Y W be an isomorphism whose projection to X is the open inclusion followed by X′→X and whose projection to W followed by W→Y′ is the open inclusion followed by f′. Then the restriction of the ambient global mate at K and the derived pullback along r of the ambient mate for f and W→Y are isomorphic as arrows in D(O_{f′⁻¹(W)}). No old-base open and no invertibility of either mate are assumed. The categories, direct images, canonical mate and derived pullback are those of [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint, def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-pullback]; restriction and ordinary base change are [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps, def-pc-derived-base-change-map], and schemes, properness, flatness and fibre products follow [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Remark 48.6.1 (Tag 0E9S), its one-open specialization; Lemma 48.5.2 (Tag 0ATR); Lemma 48.12.2 (Tag 0E4J)

proof.text: Paste the cartesian square defining X′ with the open restriction square for W. Its canonical pullback comparison is r, by the two projection identities and monicity of W→Y′. Exact restriction is the derived pullback of this open immersion.

Use [lem-sc-proper-flat-right-adjoint-restriction-open] for f′ and W. The open unit becomes invertible after applying a′ and restriction. The open counit and the invertible direct-image comparison identify the restricted a′ with c, by uniqueness of right adjoints. Together with pullback composition this supplies the two endpoint isomorphisms.

Write each canonical mate as unit, pullback of inverse conjugate of ordinary base change, and counit. Paste the W square on the left of the original square. The composite units and counits agree by the triangle identities; naturality moves them through the diagram. Ordinary base change composes under this pasting, so its conjugate and inverse also compose. The remaining open-square factor is the endpoint comparison from the preceding step. This proves commutativity of the square with invertible vertical arrows, hence the arrow isomorphism. This is the one-new-base-open case of Stacks 0E9S, using the composition argument of 0ATR. Neither horizontal arrow needs to be invertible.

theorem rightAdjoint_mate_newBase_open
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (W : Y'.Opens) [IsAffine W.toScheme]
    (c : schemeDerivedQCohCategory W.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f (W.ι ≫ g)))
    (adjc : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty W.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f (W.ι ≫ g))).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f (W.ι ≫ g))) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f (W.ι ≫ g))) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f (W.ι ≫ g)) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ c)
    (hβW : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f (W.ι ≫ g)) (W.ι ≫ g)
        (pullback.fst f (W.ι ≫ g)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (r : ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ⟶ pullback f (W.ι ≫ g))
    [IsIso r]
    (hr₁ : r ≫ pullback.fst f (W.ι ≫ g) =
      ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hr₂ : r ≫ pullback.snd f (W.ι ≫ g) ≫ W.ι =
      ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ pullback.snd f g) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk
      ((schemeOpenRestriction (pullback f g) ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι.map
          (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y Y'
            (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
            (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
            f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K))) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback r).map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f (W.ι ≫ g))).ι.map
          (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y W.toScheme
            (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
            (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
            f (W.ι ≫ g) a c adjf adjc hβW K))))
